title: imap: build_credential_store does sync file I/O on tokio thread
description: imap/src/main.rs build_credential_store is a sync fn called from async main; it calls merge_from_file which uses std::fs::read_to_string. Blocking file I/O on a tokio worker thread stalls the runtime. Only happens at startup so it rarely causes problems in practice, but it violates the project rule of no sync I/O on the main task pool and will cause confusion if the credential_file is slow (network mount, etc.).
